name: Blockamok Remix
author: Mode8fx
description_short: 3D survival game where you pilot a spaceship and dodge blocks at ever-increasing speed.
description_long: Blockamok Remix is a 3D action-survival game where you pilot a spaceship with a broken throttle and dodge incoming blocks at ever-increasing speed. This remake adds widescreen support, configurable settings, controller support, audio, menus, scoring, and performance optimizations over the original Blockamok.
